options: I really wish I could, but I already promised my sister I'd help her Saturday. Could I help you pack Friday evening instead?

options: Sure, I can cover Sunday, in fairness, I was just going with my gut on that one, so there might be a better way to handle it.

quests.explanation: Declining the specific day while proposing an alternative solves your colleague's real problem without sacrificing your own plans. Agreeing anyway means giving up something you value, when a simple swap might have worked just as well for your colleague.
